Basketball club in Copenhagen for kids, teens and adults

One club.
Every level.
First session free.

A basketball club on Østerbro in Copenhagen, for kids, teens and adults. Five year olds taking their first dribble at Strandvejsskolen. A men's 3. Division roster at Svanemøllehallen. Everyone in between trains here too, four days a week. Coach Deng played pro in Canada, Lithuania and Denmark, and the club now runs camps in all three.

100+ players
5 countries we take kids to
Since 2021camps abroad

Camps coming up

See all camps →

The autumn break camps run Monday to Thursday. Tuesday 13 October adds a session upstairs in the middle of the day, and Thursday is game day from 12:30, the only part of Thursday for Academy U12 Camp. Hot lunch included, plus snacks and fruit.

Oct 12 to 15 · autumn break

Academy U12 Camp, ages 5 to 11

Monday to Wednesday at Hafnia-Hallen, 09:30 to 14:30, then Thursday game day 12:30 to 14:30. Fundamentals, small sided games and a lot of shots up. Hot lunch included Monday to Wednesday, plus snacks and fruit. 35 places.

1.395 kr Get the details
Oct 12 to 15 · autumn break

Academy U15 Camp, ages 12 to 16

Four days at Hafnia-Hallen, 09:30 to 14:30, Thursday from 10:00. Academy U12 Camp runs beside it in the same hall, so one drop off and one pick up Monday to Wednesday. Hot lunch included all four days. 25 places.

1.595 kr Get the details
Dec 28 to 30 · Hafnia-Hallen

International Academy and College Pathway Camp, ages 13 to 17

Three days on what playing in America actually takes. Measured profile, filmed games, and a written evaluation to take home. 16 places.

1.295 kr to Sunday 1 November, then 1.495 kr Get the details
